```{r,echo=FALSE}

while(T){
    part = sample(1:199,1)
    whole = sample(20:199,1)
    perc = part/whole*100
    if(perc%%1==0 && perc<100 && whole != 100 && perc!=50){break}
}

```

Question
========

A store's normal retail price is $`r whole` per trinket. However, they are having a sale with a discount of `r perc`%.

Find the sale price.


Solution
========

This scenario represents a percent decrease. It is beneficial to find the scale factor.

$$\text{scale factor}~=~1-\frac{`r perc`}{100}~=~`r 1-perc/100`$$

Then, multiply the original cost by the scale factor to find the retail price.

$$`r 1-perc/100`\cdot `r whole` = `r whole*(1-perc/100)`$$

So the retail price is $`r round(whole*(1-perc/100))`.

============
